legal.title: Terms and Conditions
legal.disclaimer: Purchasing service from authorized agents in the United States.
legal.pageDesc: Clarification on legal status, ownership of special products, and terms of Truvamate's "purchasing service"
legal.section1Desc: Truvamate operates as a "Courier/Messenger Agent" only. We provide a purchasing service for products from America and do not act as a distributor or seller.
legal.section1Detail: Our role is: Receive your order → Have our team in the United States purchase special products from authorized retailers → Send proof of purchase to you → Store securely
legal.section2Item1: The product is 100% yours: As soon as our team makes the purchase, ownership immediately transfers to the buyer.
legal.section2Item2: Proof of ownership: Photo evidence with your name/reference code serves as proof of ownership.
legal.section2Item3: Storage: Physical products are stored in the company's safe in the state of purchase until delivery.
legal.section3LowValueDesc: We will deliver the product and transfer funds to your Truvamate account based on the product value.
legal.section3HighValueDesc: You must contact our team directly or authorize a representative to handle it, with taxes payable under US law.
legal.section3Tax: * US Tax (Federal & State Tax): Foreign buyers may be subject to tax under IRS regulations for certain imported products.
legal.section4Desc: This service constitutes a transaction under US jurisdiction (point of purchase). Truvamate acts solely as a coordinator.
legal.section4Warning: Users agree that this purchase is for personal convenience and acknowledge that some special products may have restrictions in certain countries. Users are responsible for checking the laws in their country of residence.
legal.footerNote: If you have additional legal questions, please contact our legal department.
